# synology_ftp (Resource)

FTP and FTPS service configuration. Omitted settings retain existing values. Destroy does not disable either service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable FTP.
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout in seconds.
- `maximum_connections_per_client` (Number) Maximum connections per IP address; zero means DSM default/unlimited.
- `passive_port_range` (String) Passive port range in DSM start:end syntax.
- `passive_port_range_enabled` (Boolean) Use a custom passive port range.
- `port` (Number) FTP listening port.
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Enable FTPS.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: ftp. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
